import torch
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
from torchvision import datasets, transforms

TRAIN_TF = transforms.Compose([
    transforms.Resize(64),
    transforms.RandomRotation(15),
    transforms.RandomAffine(degrees=0, scale=(0.9, 1.1)),
    transforms.ToTensor(),
    transforms.Normalize((0.2860,), (0.3530,)),
])
TEST_TF = transforms.Compose([
    transforms.Resize(64),
    transforms.ToTensor(),
    transforms.Normalize((0.2860,), (0.3530,)),
])

def load_fashion_mnist(root="data", batch_size=128):
    train = datasets.FashionMNIST(root, train=True, download=True, transform=TRAIN_TF)
    test = datasets.FashionMNIST(root, train=False, download=True, transform=TEST_TF)
    return (DataLoader(train, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=2),
            DataLoader(test, batch_size=batch_size))

import torch
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
from torchvision import datasets, transforms

TRAIN_TF = transforms.Compose([
    transforms.Resize(64),
    transforms.RandomRotation(15),
    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
    transforms.ToTensor(),
    transforms.Normalize((0.2860,), (0.3530,)),
])
TEST_TF = transforms.Compose([
    transforms.Resize(64),
    transforms.ToTensor(),
    transforms.Normalize((0.2860,), (0.3530,)),
])

def load_fashion_mnist(root="data", batch_size=128):
    train = datasets.FashionMNIST(root, train=True, download=True, transform=TRAIN_TF)
    test = datasets.FashionMNIST(root, train=False, download=True, transform=TEST_TF)
    return (DataLoader(train, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=2),
            DataLoader(test, batch_size=batch_size))
